title: Building an AI-Powered RPG Where You Type Your Attacks
author: YungMixtape2004

comments.author: YungMixtape2004
comments.body: Am working on this for a while now. Anyone doing anything similar?

replies.author: VarioResearchx
replies.body:
Hey this is amazing and I’m actually working on something incredible similar. I built an rpg engine around mcp server and then I packaged it as a binary and it runs a front end application. 

It works in pretty much the same way. The mcp server is a toolset for the ai to choose. So the player is responsible for describing what they want their character to do in natural language and the LLMs job is to be the dungeon master, push the narrative forward, and handle player intent via mechanics. 

My marketing is pretty bad it’s basically if you replaced a human dungeon master with an AI and gave it tools to do the mechanic stuff. 

https://github.com/Mnehmos/rpg-mcp this is the engine as an mcp server. 

This is the front end game.

replies.author: YungMixtape2004
replies.body:
Inspected your github, seems like a very creative game concept. Hadn't thought about using an MCP server as a dungeon master before and it also solves the need of having to pay for your llm tokens. 200 tools sounds like a lot though haha.

Do you have a youtube video so I can check out how exactly your game works?

replies.author: VarioResearchx
replies.body:
Not yet, i really need to get on that, i had a video but youtube deemed it unworthy and banned my account =/. The 200 tools is very token expensive, but the beauty of it being an mcp server is you can drag and drop to any MCP enabled client! Play on your claude code subscription or whatever you got. 

I'm working on getting a new business email set up with google and i'll start making videos then.

replies.body: It’s pointless because you can just say “I use Jesus slam which deals 99999 damage” and remives the challenge.

replies.author: YungMixtape2004
replies.body: Doesn't work like that at all. AI judgements are only part of the damage calculation formula, rest is based on classic rpg stats. AI will also judge that action as infeasible for your character so dmg will probably be 0.
